\emph{Overall objectives.} The project studies the Hodge theory of Lagrangian fibrations of
hyper-K\"ahler manifolds and related holomorphic symplectic varieties. Its objectives are
(1) to determine which decompositions of the Mumford--Tate group occur for fibers of
Lagrangian fibrations, and whether a decomposable fiber forces a hyper-K\"ahler manifold to
be deformation equivalent to a Hilbert scheme of points on a K3 surface; (2) to extend this
Hodge theory to non-compact Lagrangian fibrations, chiefly the Hitchin fibration for
$\mathrm{SL}_r$-Higgs bundles, by determining the Mumford--Tate group of its very general
fiber; and (3) to work toward the hyper-K\"ahler Bogomolov--Mumford conjecture by producing
rational curves from degenerations of fibers with an elliptic factor.

\emph{Statement of potential overlap.} None. This is the proposal under consideration, and
the PI has no other current or pending support.
